sourceStatement.latticeQuotient: Lambda/2Lambda is a 24-dimensional F2 vector space with alternating pairing induced by the Leech inner product
sourceStatement.centralExtension: the inversion-twisted ground module carries the unique 4096-dimensional irreducible representation of the extraspecial central extension 2_+^(1+24)
references: Yamauchi, The 2A-orbifold construction and the baby-monster vertex operator superalgebra, Section 6.2

executableBridge.input: the explicit Leech Gram matrix reduced modulo 2
executableBridge.algorithm: symplectic Gram-Schmidt over F2 followed by q(v)=v squared over 2 mod 2 hyperbolic normalization
executableBridge.output: twelve hyperbolic pairs (a_i,b_i) with <a_i,b_j>=delta_ij, all a-a and b-b pairings zero, and q(a_i)=q(b_i)=0
executableBridge.pauliMap: a_i maps to logical X_i and b_i maps to logical Z_i; this preserves generator squares, commutators and the central minus identity

surfaceCodeJoin.statement: The fixed-parity fusion space carries the same 12-qubit extraspecial Pauli-group presentation as the Leech twisted ground module after choosing the computed quadratic-symplectic basis.

promotion.established: an explicit presentation-preserving isomorphism from the finite extraspecial twisted-ground group to the 12-qubit real Pauli group
promotion.open: a canonical physical choice of basis, coupling to half-oscillator modes, and the lift from the finite ground-group action to the full twisted vertex-operator products

boundary: The bridge is algebraic rather than dimensional and includes the quadratic refinement, but it identifies only the finite twisted-ground extraspecial layer. It does not identify the full surface-code theory with the Leech orbifold or Moonshine VOA.
